claim: Environment investigation is ROBUST and BOUNDED: the substrate scans its world recursively, records what each thing IS structurally, and reads textual CONTENT into observations linked to what the file is about — while never decoding a binary as text, and never exceeding its scan/depth/size bounds.
hypothesis: A naive scanner either stays shallow (missing nested content), or decodes everything (turning binary bytes into fabricated 'facts'). Both failures are visible here: nested content must be found, and a NUL-containing file must yield structural metadata with ZERO content facts.

environment.database_verified_reason: no initialized connection in this process

metrics.name: entries_scanned
metrics.note: everything the bounded recursive scan found, files and directories

metrics.name: read_max_bytes
metrics.note: no file is read past this — investigation cannot become ingestion

metrics.name: structural_facts
metrics.note: what the thing IS: contains / isa / extension / size

metrics.name: content_observations
metrics.note: sentences read from real text, held as PERCEPTION-provenance observations at low quality — observations, not knowledge

metrics.name: binary_content_facts
metrics.note: MUST be 0: a NUL-containing file yields metadata only. Any other value means the substrate decoded bytes into invented facts

metrics.name: files_recorded_in_ledger
metrics.note: every content read is recorded as a READING, so Law 2 can later tell whether what the substrate holds is still what is on disk

checks.label: scan recurses into subdirectories (finds sub/b.md at depth 1)
a NUL-containing file reads as None (binary, never decoded)
a real text file reads its content
structural facts held (contains / isa / extension / size)
file CONTENT read into observations (PERCEPTION prov, source=the file, low quality)
the file is linked to what it is ABOUT (mentions)
binary file yields structural metadata but NO decoded content

notes: Uses the REAL _scan_environment / _read_text_bounded / _ingest_environment_entry bound to a minimal stand-in carrying a real ReadingLedger, so the reading-ledger side effect is exercised rather than stubbed out.
